protocol.purpose: Screen world-history and proposed HRL learning settings; no automatic policy promotion
protocol.metric: Uniform decision-time MAE of h in continuous 300-second CCC evaluation
protocol.replication_unit: independently trained policy; evaluation trials are repeated measurements
protocol.causal_limit: No noncanalizing environment control in this screen; cannot isolate the causal benefit of traversal-dependent costs

execution.main_dispatcher: baseline then canalization-300s; reuses completed later conditions
execution.note: Native process concurrency only; training and evaluation contracts remain fixed

protocol.evaluation_boundary_details: h and tile counts carry between the three reporting windows; the inherited native phase-start forward-velocity initialization remains common to every evaluated policy. These are continuous-homeostasis CCC evaluations, not a claim of uninterrupted kinematics.

checkpoint.kind: preserved selected HRL policy; fixed benchmark, not a new training replicate
